name: Elephant yam
description: Huge starchy tuber, itchy raw and eaten at Diwali.

tcm.note: Not the Chinese shan yao; placed from its pungent, drying character.

ayurveda.note: Surana is ushna, tikshna and kapha-reducing — the classical remedy for arshas (piles).

unani.note: Garam-khushk, which is why it is cooked with tamarind to cut it.

histamine.note: Low for histamine; the raw itch is calcium oxalate, a different mechanism.
